difficulty_reason: The author controls first-order quantification and unrestricted set abstraction by constructing a finite simultaneous formula-valuation map. The variable-or-closed-term restriction makes universal-left substitution range over the finite closed-term set, while universal-right uses the eigenvariable condition and a finite meet. Brouwer gives a valuation satisfying the self-referential membership equations; the complete derivation induction yields consistency. This nontrivial semantic construction is the counted main result; familiar algebraic facts and fixed-point consistency support are not separately counted.
